announcements.headline: THIRD QUARTERLY REPORT OF 2026
announcements.insight: Air China Ltd. published its third quarterly report of 2026, following the September interim results and key operating data updates.

announcements.headline: KEY OPERATING DATA OF SEPTEMBER 2026
announcements.insight: Air China Ltd. provides September operating data following its interim report in September 2026, offering routine performance updates for shareholders.

announcements.headline: 2026 Interim Report
announcements.insight: Air China Ltd. has published its 2026 Interim Report. This follows recent governance updates and a capital raise completed in June.

announcements.headline: PURCHASE OF AIRCRAFT AND NOTICE OF EGM
announcements.insight: Air China Ltd. convenes an EGM to approve aircraft purchases, following earlier A share issuance and articles updates in June and July.

announcements.headline: NOTICE OF EXTRAORDINARY SHAREHOLDERS’ MEETING
announcements.insight: Shareholders must attend the meeting to vote on the new Articles of Association following the A share issuance. This governs corporate structure changes.

announcements.headline: ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION OF AIR CHINA LIMITED
announcements.insight: Articles of Association were filed following the June A-share issuance completion. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent corporate governance updates.

announcements.headline: COMPLETION OF ISSUANCE OF A SHARES
announcements.insight: Air China Ltd. has completed the issuance of A shares. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on capital allocation or dilution effects.
